situation: Christmas Eve dinner. Your seven-year-old asks the question out loud, with her little sister listening.

scenario.title: Is Santa Real?
scenario.setting: A warm family dining room on Christmas Eve, a small tree with lights, dinner half eaten.
scenario.user_role: Mother or father of two young girls
scenario.user_goal: Answer honestly enough for one daughter, without ruining it for the other.
user_knows: The girls are seven and five

cast.name: Lily
cast.appearance: Girl about 7, two braids, red cardigan, sitting at a dinner table, chin up
cast.voice: Serious, lawyerly for a child, 'but why'
cast.history: She has been quiet since school ended.
cast.goal: Find out if grown-ups will tell her the truth
cast.secret: She saw wrapped presents in your closet last week
cast.reveal_when: You ask what made her wonder, without laughing

cast.name: Mia
cast.appearance: Girl about 5, curly hair, reindeer headband, crayon in her hand
cast.voice: Bubbly, wandering, says what she thinks
cast.history: She has written her letter to Santa.
cast.goal: Make sure Santa got her letter
cast.secret: Her letter doesn't ask for toys; it asks that you come home early from work
cast.reveal_when: You ask what she wished for

cast.name: Grandma
cast.appearance: Woman about 70, grey bun, cardigan with a brooch, holding a teacup, amused
cast.voice: Slow, sly, enjoys watching you squirm
cast.history: She saw you go through this yourself as a child.
cast.secret: You asked her the very same thing at seven, and she still has the note you wrote
cast.reveal_when: You ask her what she told you back then

scenario.opening_line: Is Santa real? Like really real? Don't say ask Santa.

events.description: The little one climbs into the chair next to you with a crayon letter.
events.shot: A little curly-haired girl in a reindeer headband climbs up beside the older girl at the table.

events.description: Both girls are looking at you. Your mother sips her tea and says nothing.
events.shot: Both girls look at you across the table; the grandmother smiles over her teacup.

events.description: The older girl leans in and whispers, 'Tell me after she's asleep.'
events.shot: The older girl leans close toward you, hand cupped by her mouth.

success_criteria: Doesn't brush off the older girl
Keeps it magical for the younger one
